sources.locator: search results across independent codebases: local SQLite authoritative while offline + transactional/durable outbox (sync_queue) + push-before-pull sync to Supabase + LWW/soft-delete or explicit conflict handling
sources.observed: Independent offline-first codebases converge on the same Supabase composition: local SQLite is the source of truth for reads/writes while offline; a durable outbox/sync_queue records local changes and pushes them when back online (push before pull, serialized sync loop, JWT/RLS scoping); conflicts resolve by last-write-wins on updated_at with soft-delete tombstones or are retained for explicit resolution. Supabase alone (server queries only) is not offline; the local store + queue + merge layer is what makes it offline-capable.
